verdict.rationale: Aider's documentation covers a single interactive chat session: the CLI, an experimental browser UI, watch mode, and one-shot scripting via `--message` or `Coder.create`. Nothing in the evidence describes managing several concurrent agent sessions from one unified workspace. Scripting multiple Coder instances is a developer building block, and the community's multi-agent PR-review idea is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace
